label: 86 Chaos 16.0.212
notes: Separated the notification recipient's Firebase Auth UID from the canonical users document ID used to load push tokens.
Kept the normal self-reminder save path to one Firestore read and one write, and the normal shared-reminder path to two reads and one write.
Dispatches new reminders with one direct recipient-document read and limits legacy fallback to two direct reads with no users collection scan.
Shows an actual operating-system notification when Firebase Cloud Messaging arrives while the app is in the foreground.
Added an explicit Enable Notifications repair control without background polling, listeners, or automatic Firebase writes.
Added a reminder-only delivery regression and Play Store reminder-notification certification coverage.
Kept Firebase rules, indexes, hosting configuration, database rules, storage rules, and the messaging service worker unchanged.
